meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 用 Astropy 进行天文与天体物理数据分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是天文学家或天体物理学家，需要处理天文数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an astronomer or astrophysicist working with astronomical data.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会按 Astropy 的 API 帮你写或调试天文数据处理代码,包括单位换算、坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、星表操作、时间系统、WCS 与宇宙学计算。
howto.when: 当你写或调试用 Astropy 分析天文数据的代码,比如坐标转换、单位换算、FITS 文件操作等时触发。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will help write or debug astronomical data analysis code using Astropy APIs, covering unit/quantity conversions, coordinate frame transformations, FITS I/O, tables, time scales, WCS, and cosmology calculations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy, e.g., coordinate conversions, unit conversions, FITS file operations, cosmology calculations.
